acceptance_criteria: ng build in frontend/learnplay produces no TypeScript compilation errors
Navigating to http://localhost:4200/courses/notifications in the browser shows the Staff Notifications page (bell icon header, 3 broadcast cards, compose form)
The sidebar shows a bell-icon 'Notifications' nav item that highlights when on /courses/notifications
Clicking 'Notify All Teachers' card with a typed message fires POST /api/staff/notify/teachers and shows the server's data string in the success alert
The Recent Notifications table shows a new row after each send attempt
The 160-character limit counter decrements as the user types in the message field
Selecting 'Individual' in the recipient dropdown shows the staff member select box populated with teacher + admin names from the GET /api/staff/teachers and GET /api/staff/admins endpoints

cd c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\frontend\learnplay && ng serve, then navigate to http://localhost:4200/courses/notifications — page must render without console errors
